item.g:title: 15 Minute Art: Drawing
item.g:description: This inspiring drawing guide offers 50 quick projects that make drawing feel playful, relaxing and wonderfully accessible. Using simple coloured pencils and markers, you’ll explore flowers, fruit, patterns, characters and more, with each project broken down into no more than six steps. Perfect for bringing a moment of focus and calm during the challenges of cancer treatment, or simply as a delightful everyday gift for someone who loves to create.

The book offers a quick overview of how to sketch your artwork, along with traceable templates that make it easy to dive straight into the pleasure of painting. Perfect for bringing a moment of focus and calm during the challenges of cancer treatment, or simply as a delightful everyday gift for someone who loves to create.

item.g:title: Bordlite ABS Hardshell Suitcase - Cabin / Black

item.g:title: Breathe by Jean Hall
item.g:description: Breathing properly is one of the simplest ways to increase your energy, improve your sleep and reduce stress. Moreover, you can practise alone, and it's free. Drawing on the practices of yoga, meditation and mindfulness, this book provides clear, step-by-step instructions for 20 exercises to improve the way you breathe. Learn the essentials such as moving breath, mindful breathing and how to rebalance the breath, and open yourself up to feelings of renewed energy. Breathe : simple breathing techniques for a calmer, happier life by Jean Hall, ISBN: 9781837830718, Hardback, 19 x 14 x 2cm, 378g, 142 pages, Quadrille Publishing, 2024,

item.g:title: Cancer Research UK Ostomy Swimsuit - 8 / VAT Exempt
item.g:description: Introducing the Cancer Research UK Ostomy Swimsuit. The Cancer Research UK Ostomy Swimsuit is designed to offer gentle support and reassuring coverage, helping you feel confident in and around the water. Its thoughtful construction provides a secure fit without compromising on comfort, making it ideal for post-surgery wear. Available in a range of sizes, this swimsuit is a confidence-boosting choice for anyone looking for swimwear that combines practicality with understated style. Features: Adjustable straps, Built in internal shelf for supporting a range of ostomy bags, Fixed pre formed cups, Soft elasticated under bust shelf, Gathers to the front, Front lined for tummy control,

Designed with comfort, confidence, and support in mind, this thoughtfully crafted swimsuit is ideal for post-surgery wear. The swimsuit includes fixed pre-formed cups with pockets to accommodate a swim prosthesis, and specially constructed internal stitching supports and keeps them in place. item.g:title: Cancer Research UK Post-Surgery Comfort Bra - S / Black / VAT Exempt
item.g:description: Introducing the Cancer Research UK Post-Surgery Comfort Bra: a bra developed by us with breast cancer patients every step of the way. Suitable for use after a mastectomy, lumpectomy, lymph node removal, or breast reconstruction. A lined pocket with removable pads also provides space to add a prothesis, if desired. It's also designed to be comfortable for everyday wear for non-patients, too. Soft, seamless, breathable bambooMade from a super soft, knitted fabric with a tubular, seamless design, the bra offers the ultimate in comfort and support. The wide, fully adjustable straps and front hook and eye fastenings ensure a perfect fit. The main fabric is derived from natural bamboo that's soft against sensitive skin, as well as being breathable, moisture wicking, and antibacterial. Ideal for all day and long-term wear. FitWe recommend your normal dress size for a comfortable fit. If you’re an E cup or above, going up one size will provide added ease and gentle support. Find out more by watching our video guide to adjusting the bra for your body. This bra funds researchOver the last 40 years, Cancer Research UK's work has helped double breast cancer survival. Every sale of this bra ensures that progress continues, with 100% of net profits funding future breast cancer research projects. 4 colour and 6 size options, Wide shoulder straps, Hook and eye fastening at centre front, with 3 adjustable settings, 100% net profits are donated directly to our breast cancer research projects,

Suitable for use after a mastectomy, lumpectomy, lymph node removal, or breast reconstruction. A lined pocket with removable pads also provides space to add a prothesis, if desired. It's also designed to be comfortable for everyday wear for non-patients, too. Soft, seamless, breathable bambooMade from a super soft, knitted fabric with a tubular, seamless design, the bra offers the ultimate in comfort and support. The wide, fully adjustable straps and front hook and eye fastenings ensure a perfect fit. The main fabric is derived from natural bamboo that's soft against sensitive skin, as well as being breathable, moisture wicking, and antibacterial. Ideal for all day and long-term wear. FitWe recommend your normal dress size for a comfortable fit. If you’re an E cup or above, going up one size will provide added ease and gentle support. Find out more by watching our video guide to adjusting the bra for your body. This bra funds researchOver the last 40 years, Cancer Research UK's work has helped double breast cancer survival. Every sale of this bra ensures that progress continues, with 100% of net profits funding future breast cancer research projects. 4 colour and 6 size options, Wide shoulder straps, Hook and eye fastening at centre front, with 3 adjustable settings, 100% net profits are donated directly to our breast cancer research projects,

item.g:title: Crochet: Just What You Need

Its gentle, absorbing focus also makes it a soothing companion during treatment or recovery.

item.g:title: Cross Everything: A personal journey into the evolution of cancer
item.g:description: When Henry Scowcroft's partner Zarah was diagnosed with stage IV bladder cancer in her mid-thirties, their world fell apart. In order to cope with the upheaval as they endured scans, aggressive chemotherapy and hospital stays, Henry began writing down and sharing their experiences with friends and family. His day job as a writer for the charity Cancer Research UK helped him to explain everything he was learning from the coalface of cancer treatment - including Zarah's diagnosis, and their rollercoaster journey through the health system. After Zarah's untimely death Henry found some closure and comfort by trying to learn more about her cancer from scientific analysis of the test results and biopsies taken during her treatment, and enlisted a team of doctors and researchers to help him. Could he have done more? How did Zarah's tumour develop? Could there be a legacy from her death that would help others diagnosed with cancer? This heart-wrenching memoir of love and loss is interspersed with Henry's mission to understand the cancer that took his partner too soon. Reviews "A moving, compelling and vital book, that sheds much needed light on the very latest understanding of cancer." Siddhartha Mukherjee, author of The Emperor of All Maladies "Sensitive and informed. Essential reading for anyone supporting a loved one through cancer." Deborah James, writer and broadcaster "A gripping, heartbreaking, accessible personal journey through love and cancer." Charles Graeber, New York Times bestselling author of The Breakthrough "Cross Everything may be the most heartbreaking medical memoir you'll read." The Daily Mail

item.g:title: Evenly Bra Balancer - 301
item.g:description: The Evenly Bra Balancer™ (sold individually) is a soft silicone breast form designed to restore balance and symmetry where additional volume is needed. Suitable for women with natural breast asymmetry, as well as those who have experienced a change in breast shape or volume following lumpectomy, partial mastectomy, reconstruction, radiotherapy or other breast surgery, it sits discreetly inside a bra cup to create a more balanced appearance, improve bra fit and help clothing sit more evenly. The Bra Balancer can be used as a partial breast form where only volume replacement is needed, or as a full breast form or swim form option following mastectomy. Made from super soft silicone, it moves naturally with the body and can be worn in everyday bras, sports bras and swimwear. Sizing differs depending on how the product is being used: For balancing a breast size difference of approximately 2–3 cup sizes, please refer to the Asymmetry Size Guide., For post-surgery use on a flat chest wall, please refer to the Post-Mastectomy Size Guide. , Features: Deep hollow back and lightly tapered edges for a secure and smooth fit, Natural breast shape, feel and projection, High-quality, soft, transparent silicone that allows your skin tone to show through and gently warms to your body temperature,

item.g:title: Evenly Subtle Shaper - 001
item.g:description: Subtle Shapers™ (sold individually) are thoughtfully designed for those who experience a slight difference in breast size or shape, including following a lumpectomy. Soft and lightweight, they sit discreetly inside the bra to help restore balance, creating a smooth, natural and even silhouette under clothing. They can also be worn as a matching pair, offering gentle coverage and modesty for everyday confidence, whatever your stage or situation. Silicone breast forms are not recommended if your surgery was very recent or if your skin is still healing – in those cases a "softie" is usually recommended. Consult with your doctor if you are unsure. Features: Made from high quality silicone, Slim, concave round shape gives a subtle boost to your bra, suitable for less than one cup size difference between your breasts, Lightly tapered edges for a secure and smooth fit, Suitable to be worn every day, even when swimming or exercising, Includes super soft Evenly storage bag to keep your bra insert clean,

item.g:description: This post‑surgery heart cushion is thoughtfully designed to offer soothing comfort and support after mastectomy, lumpectomy, or lymph node procedures. item.g:title: Robin & Bullfinch Duo 24 Christmas Cards
item.g:description: From a soft, rosy robin perched in falling snow to a delicate bullfinch resting among frosted winter berries, each Christmas card illustration captures a peaceful moment in nature. Features Pack of 24 cards with envelopes., Designs exclusive to Cancer Research UK., The message inside Robin’s Portrait reads: “With best wishes for Christmas and the New Year”., The message inside Beautiful Bullfinch reads "With best wishes for the festive season”., 15 x15 cm, posts as Royal Mail letter., Uncoated 250gsm FSC board., 100% recyclable card, envelope and packaging. For details on how to reuse or recycle your cards, visit recyclenow.com.,

item.g:title: Robin Advent Candle - Cream
item.g:description: Count down the days of Advent with this charming robin advent candle. This classic pillar candle is numbered down the centre in gold, allowing you to burn the candle each day in the countdown to Christmas. Available in two colour options, white and cream, sold separately. Each candle measures approximately 20cm tall x 5cm diameter, and has its own presentation box and clear glass base.

item.g:title: Robin Plaques - Place Like Home
item.g:description: Add a festive touch to your Christmas décor with these charming robin plaques. Nestle into the rest of our Christmas robin decorations, homewares and gifts.

item.g:title: Robins, Wrens and Other British Birds Nature Sticker Book
item.g:description: A gorgeous sticker book series created for the National Trust, packed with facts about birds and their homes. With four pages of wildlife stickers, you can launch the ducks into the pond, fill the sky with swallows, add nests to the treetops, and much more. From oystercatchers wading in the estuary to woodpeckers nesting in the woods, this is an excellent introduction to all types of birds for the very young. Robins, wrens and other British birds nature sticker book by Nikki Dyson, ISBN: 9780857639301, Paperback, 30 x 22 x 0.5cm, 220g, 24 pages, Nosy Crow, 2017,

item.g:title: Rocket Pin Badge
item.g:description: Jet off on a fantastic future together with the help of this cute rocket-shaped pin badge wedding favour.Ideal for a couple with an interest in space or exploration, or as a perfect keepsake for a child to remember your special day.Features: Rocket Wedding Favour, Approximately 3 x 1.6cm, badge 0.1cm thick, 1cm thick including pin, White backing card included, Butterfly clasp on back, Assembly required ,

item.g:title: Ronald the Classical Plush Grey Bunny
item.g:description: Take Ronald the Bunny wherever you go. His soft plush fur and long, fluffy ears make it easy for children to cuddle, carry and play with all day long. Whether he joins in imaginative games or sits close during quiet moments, Ronald brings comfort and fun to every little adventure. And with his name stitched on the foot, it feels even more personal for children who love a special friend.

item.g:title: Rose Gold Lux Foil 1.5m Christmas Wrapping Paper - Greetings
item.g:description: Shine bright this festive season with this stunningly beautiful rose gold foil wrapping paper. This design features festive words in white on a rose gold background. Available in 3 designs, sold separately, the intricate details are lifted by the luxe foil finish. 1.5m in length, this wrap is made from paper-backed foil.

item.g:title: Rose Gold Lux Foil 1.5m Christmas Wrapping Paper - Stag
item.g:description: Shine bright this festive season with this stunningly beautiful rose gold foil wrapping paper. This design features an artistic on the classic stag. Available in 3 designs, sold separately, the intricate details are lifted by the luxe foil finish. 1.5m in length, this wrap is made from paper-backed foil.

item.g:title: Royce Georgia Pocketed T-Shirt Bra - 32B / Skin
item.g:description: This Georgia pocketed t-shirt bra by Royce is a padded, everyday bra for gentle post-surgery support. For a smooth silhouette under t-shirts and close-fitting tops, it is designed with moulded, padded cups and pure cotton lined, bilateral pockets for prosthesis. Ideal for everyday wear, it features delicate, front detailed lace and a stretch back, fastened with 2 hooks. Acting as a cotton liner within the cup, this t-shirt bra can be worn by anyone without a prosthesis, making it a go-to for an attractive, every day, comfortable wear. Features: Bilateral, shaped pockets,

item.g:title: Royce Pocketed Softcup Comfi-Bra - 34B/C / Black / VAT Exempt
item.g:description: This pocketed softcup Comfi-Bra by Royce is a front fastening, all day comfort bra, to wear after surgery. Featuring a super soft feel and effective fit, this bra is created from a stretchy yet rich pima cotton fabric. For easy accessibility and reduced shoulder mobility, it features front opening poppers that are ideal for inspections of surgical areas and dressing changes. For optimum support, this bra has high sides, a crop top cut and a wide back band. It's lightly padded straps and stretch under band provide optimum support and it's cut-and-sew cups are lined with soft pockets to hold prosthesis. Features: Available in black, white, and blush, Pocketed,

item.g:title: The Little Book of Breathing
item.g:description: When your day feels rushed or your mind won’t settle, this gentle guide helps you reconnect with calm through simple breathwork. Featuring beautiful illustrations and easy exercises, it introduces yoga‑inspired breathing techniques and accessible theories of mindfulness to support moments when anxiety rises. Compact and soothing to reach for whenever you need it, it’s a thoughtful companion for anyone looking to ease tension during treatment or find more mindful pauses.

item.g:title: The Little Book of Sleep
item.g:description: If drifting into deep sleep feels difficult, this gentle little guide offers simple ways to rebuild a restful routine. Written by sleep expert Dr Nerina Ramlakhan, it blends beautiful illustrations with calming exercises and moments of creativity to help soothe a busy mind. Each page encourages you to pause, breathe and reconnect with your natural rhythm, making it easy to introduce new sleep techniques into everyday life. Perfect for keeping close during treatment days or long, unsettled nights, it offers gentle support for anyone coping with disrupted rest.

item.g:title: The Snail is Slow but Never Late
item.g:description: A Korean bestseller! In this calming and restorative book, Korean Buddhist nun Jung‑mok invites us to slow down, breathe more deeply and loosen the grip of our hectic modern lives. Through stories inspired by nature and grounded in Buddhist philosophy, she shares simple practices and gentle wisdom that help us rediscover clarity, gratitude and inner stillness. Quiet, comforting and beautifully made, it’s especially reassuring for those navigating difficult seasons such as cancer treatment.

item.g:title: Trulife Barbara Everyday Pocketed Softcup Bra in White - 32A / White / VAT Exempt
item.g:description: This Barbara everyday pocketed softcup bra in white by Trulife is a medium support bra, perfect for everyday use.Designed to enhance confidence, all-day comfort and support, this bra has a versatile fit. item.g:description: The Initial softie breastform with bag by Trulife, is a soft, lightweight, symmetrical, triangle shape form for post-surgery and leisurewear. To stay free from pressure and enhance comfort within sensitive areas, it features a seamless mould for a natural, flattering shape and soft fabric. It's unique moisture-wicking COOLMAX® fabric on the rear offers breathability and moisture control to keep the skin cool and comfortable. Designed for use after breast surgery, between radiation therapy sessions, for leisure wear or due to lymphedema or skin sensitivity. item.g:title: Unplug and Unwind
item.g:description: Checking our phones and engaging online are often necessary to stay connected and thrive in today's world but doing so constantly and mindlessly can lead to unwanted anxiety, exhaustion and discontent. There is a better way to meet these everyday challenges. Through a mindful approach and relating to situations differently, Unplug and Unwind will do just that for you. In this compendium of beautiful images and inspiring guidance, shift from doing to being and find more balance and happiness in your life. Unplug and unwind : mindful ways to rest, relax, and feel renewed, ISBN: 9781800653061, Hardback, 15 x 12 x 2cm, 238g, 144 pages, Ryland, Peters & Small, 2024,

item.g:description: Discover the wonderful world under the sea, with this delightful set of jigsaws and a book.Each sturdy jigsaw comes in two easy-to-match pieces, with charming illustrations by Stella Baggott.This is the perfect way to introduce young minds to simple problem solving, reading time and all kinds of amazing sea creatures, from crabs to seahorses and dolphins.Features: Under the Sea First Jigsaws with illustrations by Stella Baggott, ISBN: 9781474988551,

item.g:title: Veho ZB-1 Wireless Bluetooth In-Ear Sports Headphones
item.g:description: These ZB-1 wireless Bluetooth in-ear sports headphones by Veho are lightweight and comfortable wireless headphones.They include soft silicone ear buds to prevent noise leakage, over ear hook stability to ensure the earbuds are held firmly in place and its lightweight design makes them unnoticeable when worn.It's designed to extend overall usage time with a built-in rechargeable battery to give you up to 8 hours of listening, perfect if you're on the go.Features: 30g, Low energy Bluetooth connection, Built in microphone and single remote gives easy access to volume controls and a single multi-function button to skip tracks and answer calls, Changeable in-ear silicon buds, 10mm acoustic driver system enhances bass and delivers crystal clear balanced audio, Up to 8 hours listening on a single charge,

item.g:description: Escape to the heart of the countryside with this 1,000-piece jigsaw puzzle, featuring a beautifully illustrated village scene full of charm and natural beauty. item.g:title: Walking Meditations
item.g:description: Walking meditation, also known as Kinhin meditation, is widely practiced in Buddhism. It can be done in a few steps at home, a short walk on a bustling street, or a longer hike in the countryside. This beautifully illustrated book will guide you through the process of finding inner peace while on the move, with a selection of meditations for every season, long and short walks in both a natural and an urban setting, and meditations for calmness, creativity and focus. Walking meditations by Danielle North, ISBN: 9781783255627, Hardback, 18 x 13 x 2cm, 332g, 160 pages, Octopus Publishing, 2023,

item.g:title: We Are Together
item.g:description: On our own, we're special, and we can chase our dream. But when we join up, hand in hand, together, we're a team. Celebrate the power of love and friendship in this beautiful book by award-winning illustrator and author Britta Teckentrup. With vibrant artwork and peek-through pages, this is a picture book to treasure.

item.g:title: When Things Don't Go Your Way
item.g:description: Life doesn't always go our way. Loss, rejection, uncertainty and loneliness are unavoidable - but there is solace to be found even in moments of greatest difficulty. Through a combination of beautiful illustrations, insightful stories, and contemplative aphorisms, Zen Buddhist teacher Haemin Sunim helps us reframe our mindsets and develop emotional agility. Whether you're in the midst of a crisis or simply seeking to improve your mental and emotional wellbeing, this book will provide courage and comfort when you need it most. When things don't go your way : zen wisdom for difficult times by Haemin Sunim, ISBN: 9780241457290, Hardback, 18 x 13 x 3cm, 538g, 272 pages, Penguin Books, 2024,

item.g:title: Wooden Heart Pin Badge
item.g:description: Give your guests a little something to remember your special day and show you care with this wooden interlocked heart pin badge. The eye-catching heart design makes a beautiful accessory and keepsake. item.g:title: Wooden Reindeer with Tree LED Light Tube Decoration
item.g:description: Add a touch of sparkle to any room with this sleek, LED lit reindeer and tree light tube. Inside the glass tube, a pair of reindeer sit below a tall tree, surrounded by pinecones, foliage and snow. A twist of micro-LEDs add a gentle, warm glow to the decoration. item.g:title: Wooden Santa with Tree Decoration
item.g:description: This festive gonk-looking decoration brings a playful twist to traditional décor with its Christmas tree hat and charming wooden base. Featuring a fluffy white beard and cheerful design, it’s perfect for mantlepieces, shelves, or tabletops. A fun seasonal accent that adds character and warmth to your home. This product measures 9 x 5 x 20 cm.

item.g:description: This distinctive tree design lantern is sure to add a festive charm to your home decor this season. Available in two sizes, the black metal lantern is gold coloured on the inside to allow a tealight to reflect brightly and allow the shadows of woodland scene to dance around the room. Features: Woodland Scene Black Tree Metal Lantern, Available in two sizes: small (18 x 10 x 26cm) and large (21 x 9.5 x 37cm), Metal hanging loop, Warning:Take care if using with real candles. For safety, we recommend the use of LED tealights. 5017224992276 / 5017224992269

item.g:title: Woodland Treehouse 500-Piece Jigsaw Puzzle
item.g:description: Escape into a magical winter scene with the Woodland Treehouse Jigsaw. This 500-piece puzzle (61 x 46 cm) features a cosy treehouse nestled in a snowy forest, complete with festive décor and charming woodland animals. Ideal for ages 10+, it's perfect for family fun or a thoughtful seasonal gift. Features: 500-piece Woodland Treehouse design jigsaw puzzle, Made from high quality coated board, Exclusive to Cancer Research UK , When you've completed your puzzle, why not donate it to your nearest Cancer Research UK shop to be loved by someone else? Find your nearest shop or superstore here.

item.g:title: Wordsearch
item.g:description: Exercise your brain, reduce stress, and expand your vocabulary with this pretty, pocket-sized wordsearch. Inside, you’ll find a variety of themed wordsearches, from pets to baking, offering bite‑sized challenges that fit effortlessly into free time. Lightweight and simple to enjoy anywhere, it’s a lovely way to unwind or to gift someone who needs gentle distraction and comfort during treatment or recovery.

item.g:title: Wreath & Tree Duo 24 Christmas Cards
item.g:description: Send season’s greetings in style with this contemporary Christmas card pack, featuring two beautifully balanced designs. A classic watercolour wreath is paired with a modern minimalist tree illustration, blending tradition with a fresh, elegant twist. Perfect for sharing warm wishes with a refined, up-to-date festive feel. Features Designs exclusive to Cancer Research UK., 24 Christmas cards with envelopes, The message inside Wonderfully Vibrant Wreath reads: “With best wishes for Christmas and the New Year”., The message inside Stunning Silver Tree Trio reads "Have a wonderful Christmas and a very happy New Year”., 15 x15 cm, posts as Royal Mail letter., Uncoated 250gsm FSC board., 100% recyclable card, envelope and packaging. For details on how to reuse or recycle your cards, visit recyclenow.com.,

item.g:title: Y Ddraig Goch 10 Welsh Bilingual Christmas Cards
item.g:description: Celebrate a classic Cymru Christmas with this bold Welsh Dragon card. This adorable dragon is wearing his Welsh flag Christmas jumper whilst firing up some festive magic. Features: Pack of 10 cards with envelopes., Design exclusive to Cancer Research UK., Inside greeting reads: Nadolig Llawen a Blwyddyn Newydd Dda / With best wishes for Christmas and the New Year., 15x15cm, posts as Royal Mail letter., Uncoated 250gsm FSC board., 100% recyclable card, envelope and packaging. For details on how to reuse or recycle your cards, visit recyclenow.com.,

item.g:title: Yin & Yang Pin Badge
item.g:description: Slot the missing piece into your wedding day with this Yin & Yang Pin Badge. A design taken from the familiar Chinese philosophical Yin Yang concept with a sparkly twist, it is often recognised as a symbol of the balance of opposing forces; good and bad, positive and negative and ups and downs. With significance to marriage values and uniting two together, it is a complimentary way to celebrate a union, as well a touching keepsake for your guests to take away. Features: Butterfly clutch fitting, Backing card included, Assembly required, The poly bags used are made from Polypropylene material which is recycled,

item.g:title: You Are Amazing Greetings Card
item.g:description: A light-hearted encouragement card to send love, support and positivity to someone you love. It can be difficult to know what to say, but reaching out with much-needed gentle encouragement will go along way. You'll be sure to make a thoughtful impression.

item.g:title: You Are Blooming Lovely Artificial Succulent Plant
item.g:description: Brighten everyday moments with a small touch of positivity. This miniature artificial plant brings a calming burst of greenery to desks, shelves or bedside tables, creating a cosy spot of nature without any upkeep. The sturdy pot and realistic foliage make it an effortless addition to any room, ideal for those who want décor that simply works. With its uplifting message, it becomes a thoughtful reminder for someone special. Includes the phrase "you are blooming lovely".

item.g:title: You Are Loved Greetings Card
item.g:description: Let your close ones know you're thinking of them during their cancer journey with this You Are Loved card. If you know someone who's going through cancer treatment, a greetings card could give them a bit of much-needed light relief.

item.g:title: You Are Not Alone Card
item.g:description: Struggling to find the right words? This you are not alone card helps you say the harder things to a friend or family member who needs the encouragement whilst dealing with cancer.The motivational and bold messaging is a cheerful pick-me-up to let close ones know you're thinking of them.Features: Pack of 1, Blank on the inside,

item.g:title: You Are Strong Greetings Card
item.g:description: Whatever your loved one is going through, reach out to them with this You Are Strong card. You will definitely put a smile on their face. It's difficult to know what to say to loved ones going through treatment and recovery, but a little goes a long way. Reach out with gentle reassurance to those who need encouragement the most, with this motivational greetings card. Blank on the inside for your own message.

item.g:title: You Are Tough Greetings Card
item.g:description: Send a message of encouragement to let a loved one know you're thinking of them at a tough time with this Life is tough but so are you greetings card. Features: Greetings card with envelope, 16 x 18cm, Foil finish,

item.g:title: You Rang The Chemo Bell Card
item.g:description: This "you rang the chemo bell" card is a considerate way to reach out to a close one who has just completed their cancer treatment.It can be hard to know what to write to someone who is going through cancer, but this lighthearted and humorous approach will sure make a lasting impression.There are many serious conversations to be had when you're diagnosed with cancer, but the silly moments are important too!Features: Single card, Blank on the inside,

item.g:title: You've Got This Greetings Card
item.g:description: Send a message of encouragement to let a loved one know you're thinking of them at a tough time with this You've Got This rainbow greetings card. Features: Greetings card with envelope, 16 x 18cm, Gold foil finish,
